title: This Official ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Children’s Book Is Made for the ‘Little’ Fans – Shop Here
summary: The illustrated Little Golden Books title is available to purchase on Amazon and at Barnes & Noble.
contentText:

Based on the hit Netflix animated film, Little Golden Book has just dropped a KPop Demon Hunters book, aptly titled For the Fans! (KPop Demon Hunters): Official Storybook.

Created by Angela Song, this official illustrated book hit shelves Dec. 30 and is available to shop now at Amazon for a $6.51 hardcover version or $5.99 for a Kindle version and at Barnes & Noble for $6.99 hardcover and $5.99 for an eBook version. Just like the movie, this book centers around the talented demon-slaying girl group HUNTR/X with members Rumi, Mira and Zoey.

For the Fans! (KPop Demon Hunters): Official Storybook (Little Golden Books)

$6.51

Buy Now On Amazon

A KPop Demon Hunters book from Little Golden Books.

As you read, you’ll also meet the Saja Boys, the hottest demon boy band, along with beloved animal characters like Derpy Tiger and Sussie. The illustrations, done by Little Golden Books, are absolutely adorable and come in a stylized chibi fashion in captivating color. The book deep-dives into the story of each lovable character and their day-to-day singing for sold-out shows before adoring fans to fighting demons post ramyun and kimbap session. This book is recommended for ages two to five; however, we’d argue that For the Fans! (KPop Demon Hunters): Official Storybook is perfect for all ages, including adults, looking for more KPop Demon Hunters content.

Little Golden Book Biographies has books on a slew of top artists today, including Taylor Swift, Lady Gaga, Harry Styles, Cher and Beyonce. It gives kids the chance to feel closer to their favorite musicians in an easily digestible manner. If you want even more K-Pop, Little Golden Books also has biographies on groups like BTS and BLACKPINK now on Amazon for $5.57 and $5.58 , respectively. Both books on the K-Pop groups are currently number one best-sellers on Amazon and capitalize on the popularity of the genre all over the globe.

For the Fans! (KPop Demon Hunters): Official Storybook (Little Golden Books)

Buy Now at barnes & Noble $6.99 $6.99

A KPop Demon Hunters book from Little Golden Books.

For those of you who might not be familiar with KPop Demon Hunters , the Netflix animated film dropped on the streaming platform back in June, capitalizing on the popularity of K-pop. The film follows a fictional world-renowned K-pop girl group called HUNTR/X consisting of members Rumi, Mira and Zoey. The group sings and performs while secretly slaying demons when not on stage.

KPop Demon Hunters: The Official Poster Book

KPop Demon Hunters official poster book.

The punchy and interactive visuals and Billboard chart-topping musical score , composed by Marcelo Zarvos, make for a thrilling ride from start to finish. The film and its soundtrack is so popular in fact that it earned five Grammy nominations for the 2026 awards, including major categories like song of the year, making history for K-pop representation at the award show.

While you’re at it, why not check out this official KPop Demon Hunters poster book that just dropped on Amazon? The book includes more than 35 colorful and interactive posters that fans can stick on their walls to bring K-pop flair to their space. The book is currently on sale for $11.76 .
